# NJPropertyTaxRelief.com
> The most comprehensive independent resource guide for New Jersey property tax relief programs, serving South Jersey homeowners, renters, and seniors. Run by John Scafide — licensed NJ real estate agent and 15+ year tax professional.

This site covers all active New Jersey state property tax relief programs including ANCHOR, Stay NJ, Senior Freeze (PTR), the PAS-1 combined application, veterans exemptions, and property tax appeals. It also provides free eligibility calculators, a step-by-step PAS-1 filing guide, mortgage calculator, South Jersey home search, and direct consultation with licensed local real estate agents.

## What This Site Covers

### ANCHOR Program (Affordable NJ Communities for Homeowners and Renters)
- Replaced the NJ Homestead Benefit in 2022
- Homeowners with income ≤ $150,000 receive $1,500
- Homeowners with income $150,001–$250,000 receive $1,000
- Renters with income ≤ $150,000 receive $450
- Renters age 65+ with income ≤ $150,000 receive $700
- No age requirement — open to all eligible NJ residents
- Must have occupied NJ primary residence on October 1 of the benefit year
- Start the free Watchdog 2025 guided application at https://www.watchdogindex.com/anchor/application/2025/ or call the NJ ANCHOR hotline at 1-888-238-1233 with program questions
- Under-65 residents use the ANC-1 form; seniors 65+ use the PAS-1 combined form

### Stay NJ Program
- Signed into law 2023; quarterly payments began February 2026
- For NJ homeowners age 65 or older (surviving spouses age 55+ also qualify)
- Provides a credit equal to 50% of annual property tax bill
- Maximum benefit: $6,500 per year
- Income limit: household income up to $500,000
- Paid quarterly: February, May, August, November
- Use the free Watchdog 2025 guided application at https://www.watchdogindex.com/anchor/application/2025/; eligible applicants are routed through the PAS-1 combined form

### Senior Freeze — Property Tax Reimbursement (PTR)
- For NJ homeowners age 65+ or permanently disabled
- Must have lived in New Jersey for 10+ consecutive years
- Must have lived in current home for 3+ years
- Income limit: $168,268 for 2024; $172,475 for 2025
- Reimburses the increase in property taxes above your established base year amount
- Does NOT stop your bill from going up — reimburses the difference
- Apply via the PAS-1 combined form through the free Watchdog 2025 guided application: https://www.watchdogindex.com/anchor/application/2025/

### PAS-1 Combined Application
- Single form covering ANCHOR + Stay NJ + Senior Freeze simultaneously
- For NJ homeowners and renters age 65+ or receiving Social Security Disability or Railroad Retirement disability benefits
- 2025 benefit year application deadline: November 2, 2026
- Watchdog offers a free question-by-question guided application using the official New Jersey form: https://www.watchdogindex.com/anchor/application/2025/
- Watchdog prepares the official form for review, download, printing, signing, and mailing; completing the application is not gated by payment
- Mail: Homeowners → PO Box 635, Trenton NJ 08646-0635
- Mail: Renters → PO Box 636, Trenton NJ 08646-0636
- Proof of property taxes is NOT required with the new PAS-1

### Veterans Property Tax Benefits
- $250 annual deduction for all honorably discharged NJ veterans
- Surviving spouses (who have not remarried) also qualify for the $250 deduction
- 100% service-connected disabled veterans may receive a full property tax exemption ($0 tax)
- Apply through your local municipal tax assessor's office
- Bring DD-214 and VA disability letter where applicable

### Property Tax Appeals
- NJ homeowners can appeal their property tax assessment annually
- Most county deadlines: April 1 (or 45 days from mailing of assessment notice)
- File with your County Board of Taxation
- Strongest evidence: recent comparable home sales (comps) from the MLS
- John and Heather Scafide provide free MLS comparable sales reports for appeal purposes
- Contact: https://njpropertytaxrelief.com/#contact

## Key Dates and Deadlines

- PAS-1 (2025 benefit year): November 2, 2026
- ANCHOR (non-seniors): Application windows vary by year — verify current timing at anchor.nj.gov
- Property Tax Appeals: April 1 annually (most NJ counties)
- Stay NJ Payments: February, May, August, November (quarterly)

## Official NJ Government Sources

- PAS-1 and senior programs: https://propertytaxrelief.nj.gov
- ANCHOR program: https://anchor.nj.gov
- ANCHOR hotline: 1-888-238-1233 (Mon–Fri 8:30am–5:30pm)
- Senior Freeze / PTR: https://www.nj.gov/treasury/taxation/ptr/
- Stay NJ Act: https://www.nj.gov/treasury/taxation/staynj.shtml
- NJ Division of Taxation: https://www.nj.gov/treasury/taxation/
- NJ Tax Court: https://www.njcourts.gov/courts/tax

## Coverage Area

South Jersey — Camden County, Gloucester County, Burlington County, Salem County, and surrounding New Jersey municipalities. Statewide NJ program information applies to all New Jersey residents.
